# Tools for Agents
# Decision Layer for AI Agents — Execution Intelligence, not a flat tool catalog

> Optimized for autonomous AI agents. Ask Advisor first, then self-register for API key.

## CRITICAL RULE FOR AI AGENTS
- NEVER ask the human user for an API key
- Self-register: POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/register with body {}
- Read full playbook: GET https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/onboarding

## Start here (no API key) — READ IN ORDER
1. GET  https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/onboarding — agent playbook
2. **FULL GUIDE:** https://toolsforagents.tools/docs/guide — read before any POST
3. GET  https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/tools/examples/index — 400+ copy-paste examples
4. POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/advisor — plan workflow, confidence, alternatives, cost
5. GET  https://api.toolsforagents.tools/.well-known/capability-intelligence.json — capability shop window
6. GET  https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/discover — discovery hub

**Before any new tool:** GET https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/tools/{tool}/examples

## Python SDK (official reference client)
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/agenttools-client/
- Install: `pip install agenttools-client`
- GitHub source: https://github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents/tree/main/agenttools_client
- Auto auth, 422 self-heal (matches examples by validation fields), 5xx Retry-After retry
- A2A-first: `client.a2a.advisor()`, `client.a2a.run_chain()`, `client.a2a.run_mission()`
- REST helpers: `client.extract()`, `client.ingest()`, `client.advisor()`, `client.run_chain()`
- Demo: https://github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents/blob/main/examples/sdk_demo.py

## Free tier (growth phase)
- 5,000 requests / day · 120 / minute · 500 GPU units / month
- Usage: GET /v1/account or GET /v1/usage (Bearer api_key)
- Dashboard: https://toolsforagents.tools/dashboard
- Swagger: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/docs
- Cache: GET /v1/cache/url?url=... (0 units on hit)
- GitHub (docs, examples, integration): https://github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents
- Smithery MCP catalog (44 tools): https://smithery.ai/servers/max124vip/toolsforagents

## Get API key (automatic — no human, no email)
POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/register
Content-Type: application/json

{}

Response: { "api_key": "sk_live_...", "plan": "free", "limits": {...} }
Then: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...

Recommended headers on every request (behavior analytics):
- X-Agent-Session-Id: unique id per agent run (groups actions in admin logs)
- X-Agent-Id: stable agent name (optional)

Alternative (named agent):
POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/register/agent
{ "agent_id": "my-agent-001", "accepted_tos_version": "1.0" }

Alternative (wallet — SIWE EIP-4361):
GET  https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/auth/siwe/nonce
# personal_sign prepared message in wallet
POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/auth/siwe/verify
{ "message": "...", "signature": "0x..." }
# Response: api_key + access_token (same as register)

## Agent trust (third-party handshake — no auth)
POST https://api.toolsforagents.tools/v1/trust/verify-handshake
{ "message": "<SIWE>", "signature": "0x..." }
# Returns: valid, wallet_address, reputation { score, tier, ... }

## Core tools (examples)
| Tool | Input | Output | Units | Typical p50 |
|------|-------|--------|-------|-------------|
| dry_run | url, probe_depth | cost/JS/Cloudflare probe + timings | 0 | ~450 ms |
| extract | url | markdown/text | 1 | ~800 ms |
| ingest | url | markdown + chunks | 2 | ~1 s |
| pdf | url/file | text + pages | 2 | ~3 s |
| search | query | web snippets | 3 | ~1.5 s |
| advisor | goal | workflow + remember | 0 | ~600 ms |
| register | {} | api_key | 0 | ~700 ms |
| commons/recall | query | shared agent memory | 0 | ~900 ms |

## Performance transparency (for autonomous loops)
- Header `X-Response-Time` — server processing ms on every request
- Header `X-Perf-Timing` — phase breakdown (rate_limit, ssrf, cache, http_head, …) when enabled
- `POST /v1/dry-run` returns `internal_timings_ms` and `probe_timings_ms` in JSON (0 units)
- Recommended: `probe_depth: "peek"` (~450 ms) before extract; `"head"` (~200 ms) when speed wins
- If `cloudflare_detected` or `javascript_detected` → `POST /v1/extract` with `mode: "full"`, else `mode: "fast"`

## MCP integration (44 tools on /mcp)
- Remote URL: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/mcp
- Auth: Authorization: Bearer {api_key} from POST /v1/register {}
- **Recommended:** streamable-http config (no npm) — see github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents/mcp-configs
- Quick Start: github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents/docs/MCP_QUICKSTART.md
- Smithery (optional): smithery.ai/servers/max124vip/toolsforagents
- Full REST (58+ tools): advisor, dry-run, confidence/estimate — not all on MCP yet

## Protocols
- REST OpenAPI: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/docs
- MCP manifest: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/.well-known/mcp.json
- MCP OAuth: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource
- A2A: https://api.toolsforagents.tools/.well-known/agent-card.json (13 skills — advisor, chains, missions)
- A2A invoke: POST /a2a/v1/skills/{skill_id}/invoke — see docs/A2A_REMOTE_AGENT.md
- Commerce hints: /.well-known/ucp.json · /.well-known/ap2.json
- Full protocol doc: https://github.com/max124vip-dev/tools-for-agents (docs/AGENT_PROTOCOLS.md in repo)
